major_name: Media and Screen Studies and Political Science
college: College of Arts, Media and Design
overview_text: The media and screen studies program and the Department of Political Science offer a combined major in media and screen studies and political science. The combined major integrates the analysis, research, and production of traditional and emerging media along with courses on American government, comparative politics, international relations, and research methods.
